title: Hacker News: A Million Falcons Went Missing. Here’s How They Were Found
description: HN Score: 26 pts | Comments: 4 | A Million Falcons Went Missing. Here’s How They Were Found

ko.title: 백만 마리의 매가 사라졌다. 어떻게 찾아냈나
ko.hook: 고급 추적 기술과 글로벌 협력이 어떻게 대규모 멸종 위기를 막아냈는지
key_takeaways: 매 개체 수 급감에 대한 경고
GPS 추적기와 드론 활용으로 사라진 새들 위치 추적
협업적인 구조 작업으로 개체 수 회복에 성공

en.title: When a Million Falcons Vanished, This Is How They Were Found
en.hook: A massive wildlife rescue operation used tech and teamwork to locate and save millions of missing falcons
key_takeaways: Critical decline in falcon populations triggered urgent response
Advanced tracking technologies (GPS, drones) played a pivotal role
Coordinated international effort restored the missing birds

zh.title: 百万猎鹰失踪，这就是如何找到它们的
zh.hook: 通过高科技追踪和全球合作，成功找回了失踪的猎鹰
key_takeaways: 猎鹰数量急剧减少引发警惕
GPS追踪和无人机技术成为关键工具
国际合作拯救了这些珍贵的鸟类
